milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the spruce planks wall (centered at spawn-relative [0, 2, 6]) and face it. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walks up to the wall rather than satisfying the milestone from spawn (~6 blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_door places the item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 6 oak planks and a nearby crafting table. The recipe yields 3 oak doors from 6 planks; we check for min_count=1 to be appropriately lenient. The player does NOT start with any oak_door, so any oak_door in inventory confirms successful crafting.
